subheading: Turn a prompt or your own lyrics into a complete song with vocals using open ComfyUI workflows built on the ACE-Step music models.
extendedDescription:
An ai song generator should give you a finished song, not a locked preview behind a subscription. The workflows on this page run ACE-Step, an open music model family, inside ComfyUI, so the whole pipeline from lyrics to final mix is visible and editable. The featured Song Generator writes BPM-aware and duration-aware lyrics for you, or takes lyrics you wrote yourself, then generates and exports the complete track.

Because the graph is open, you decide how the song is made. Set the tempo, the duration, and the style prompt; keep your own hook and let the model fill the verses; or regenerate a single section until the phrasing lands. The sibling workflows cover the lighter jobs: Text to Song turns a short description straight into a sung track, and the ACE Step text-to-song workflow exposes the classic prompt-plus-lyrics setup for full manual control.

Everything runs as a normal ComfyUI workflow, on Comfy Cloud in the browser with nothing to install, or locally in your own ComfyUI. The output is a standard audio file you can take into any editor, and the workflow itself can be rewired, extended with other audio nodes, or combined with the video workflows on this site to score a clip you just generated.

howToUse: Open the Song Generator on Comfy Cloud with the Try button, or load the workflow in your local ComfyUI.
Describe the song you want, or switch to your own lyrics and paste them in.
Set the duration and tempo so verses and chorus land where you want them.
Run the workflow and listen to the generated track in the output panel.
Adjust the style prompt or lyrics and re-run until the song fits, then export the audio file.

faqItems.question: Can the AI write the lyrics for me?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The featured Song Generator writes BPM-aware and duration-aware lyrics from your description, and you can edit them or supply your own before generating.

faqItems.question: Can I use my own lyrics?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Paste your lyrics into the workflow and the model performs them as written, so the generated song keeps your exact words.

faqItems.question: What model do these workflows use?
faqItems.answer: The song workflows are built on the ACE-Step music model family, an open set of models for lyrics-to-song and text-to-song generation.

faqItems.question: Do I need to install anything?
faqItems.answer: No. Every workflow on this page runs on Comfy Cloud in the browser. You can also download the workflow and run it in a local ComfyUI install.

faqItems.question: How is this different from the AI music generator page?
faqItems.answer: This page focuses on songs with vocals and lyrics. The AI music generator page covers instrumental music, sound design, and audio without vocals.
